finalText:
Redis died first. Everything else fell over.

```
02:14:07 ERROR [api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379
02:31:52 FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down
```
Cache fell back to direct store reads. The miss storm overloaded the store. 173 timeouts at 5000ms followed. Queue passed its max 500 at 02:29:12. Then worker-2 hit OOM and died. All 13 redis reconnects were refused. Fix 10.0.0.12:6379 first.
